qualification: Seeded Debian flushed file across cold boots

first_boot.scope: Pinned Ed25519 SSH, aarch64 identity, canonical host-backed net/block/console, fresh file written and synced

second_boot.guest_error: systemd: Failed to fork off sandboxing environment for executing generators: Protocol error; Failed to start up manager; Freezing execution
second_boot.termination: Owned QEMU PID 3794385 terminated after retaining the explicit fatal guest error. The harness then returned exit 2 for the closed CC transport; it did not independently classify the systemd failure.

offline_disk_inspection.witness_read: debugfs 1.47.0 read /var/lib/agentos/persistence-proof from the extracted partition: exactly seeded-cold-boots-gMJl2A followed by newline
offline_disk_inspection.readonly_fsck: e2fsck -fn exited 4: journal recovery skipped; orphan_present flag set with clean orphan file. No other errors reported by this check.
offline_disk_inspection.journal_replay: Replayed only on a separate copy. Subsequent read-only check still exited 4 for orphan_present; retained source disk was not modified.
offline_disk_inspection.scope: Confirms stored witness bytes on the disk left by the failed second boot. Does not establish successful guest-side readback, filesystem health after orderly shutdown, or the cause of the systemd failure.

limitations: File persistence is not qualified: the second guest did not reach the read-only witness check.
The fatal generator error is observed; timeout, storage corruption and other causes have not been distinguished.
No concurrent writable-disk isolation, guest-slot recreation or release claim.
